_comment: Copy this file to .secrets.json (same folder) and fill in your own keys. .secrets.json is LOCAL ONLY — never commit or share it. You can paste the Gemini/ElevenLabs/Pexels keys via the Studio UI instead of editing this file. Only geminiKey + elevenKey are required; pexelsKey (real-artifact cutaways) and YouTube are optional. veoEnabled stays false unless you turn on Veo image→video in the Scenes tab (slow/pricey + needs Veo access on the Gemini key).
